research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Aktis Oncology is researching radiopharmaceutical compositions described as miniproteins, conjugates, and uses thereof and miniproteins, conjugates and their uses. They design Nectin four miniprotein conjugates and B seven H three miniprotein conjugates as radionuclide conjugates to treat, diagnose, monitor, or image target expressing diseases. They also pursue decreased retention of miniproteins in the kidney and decoy miniproteins, compositions, and methods of use, covering targeting, conjugation, and renal clearance.

overview_description.description: Aktis Oncology is a biotechnology company pioneering the discovery and development of a new class of targeted radiopharmaceuticals to treat a broad range of solid tumor cancers. Founded and incubated by MPM Capital, the company has developed proprietary platforms to generate tumor-targeting agents with ideal properties for alpha radiotherapy. Designed for high tumor penetration and long residence time, Aktis Oncology's molecules will quickly clear other areas of the body, thereby maximizing tumor elimination while minimizing the side effects of treatment. This approach would also enable clinicians to visualize and verify target engagement prior to exposure to therapeutic radioisotopes.
